//: Deno config for the edge functions only. The repo root has a package.json (the Expo app), which makes Deno switch to node_modules resolution and then fail on any npm: specifier the app itself doesn't install — that is exactly how CI broke on npm:@anthropic-ai/sdk. The Supabase edge runtime has no node_modules at all, so 'none' is also the truthful production setting: resolve npm: from Deno's own cache, never from the app's tree.
